title: Salesforce Administrator
summary: A Salesforce administrator looks after a company's Salesforce system, the customer relationship management (CRM) tool its sales and service teams use, by setting it up through clicks rather than code. You sit between the business users and the developers: you add users and permissions, build reports and simple automations, keep data clean and pass coding work to Salesforce developers.
dailyDuties: Add users and manage profiles, permission sets and roles
Build reports and dashboards for sales and service leaders
Create fields, validation rules and Flows from business requests
Import and clean records with Data Loader
Test changes in a sandbox and move them to production
Answer user tickets and run training sessions

skills.expectation: Configure objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules and Flows without code
Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles and sharing rules
Import, update and clean records with Data Loader and duplicate rules
Build Salesforce reports and dashboards for business teams
Know Sales Cloud or Service Cloud processes well
Turn business requests into configuration changes
Train users and answer their support tickets
Read Apex and write SOQL queries to support developers
Test changes with users in a sandbox before release
Prepare and check data files before imports
Work in sprints with a Salesforce team
Write user guides and release notes
